'''DG-93''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] greeted a group of Republic aligned individuals on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], who then traveled to take part in the [[Battle of Ilum]].<ref name="TOR" />
